test_case.test_name: Parameterized SSD sequential-read512B QD1 sustained fio validation
test_case.purpose: Measure sustained512-byte sequential-read IOPS, bandwidth and latency on the explicitly bound SSD target for the full source duration and compare to its approved specification.
required_package: Non-production target path plus serial/model/firmware and ownership
Filesystem/raw, mount, RAID, controller/link/cache/read-ahead and OS-disk exclusion proof
Approval for10s ramp and43200s runtime with thermal/SMART abort limits
Versioned IOPS/BW/latency thresholds/tolerances and repetition policy
test_case.test_command: Capture device/topology/data-ownership and health baseline; resolve and positively verify the approved filename is not an OS, mounted-data or protected RAID member; validate the pinned fio binary; hash the exact job containing `rw=read`, `bs=512b`, `iodepth=1`, `numjobs=1`, `ramp_time=10s`, `runtime=43200s`, `time_based`; verify version-specific `overwrite=1` cannot cause writes in this read job; run once and preserve full structured plus console output and telemetry.
test_case.expected_result: The exact read profile completes for43200 seconds after the10-second ramp with zero I/O errors and zero writes, remains within health/thermal limits, and all bound IOPS/BW/latency metrics meet their approved thresholds.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires verified target identity/safety, exact achieved profile/duration, complete output, zero writes/errors, healthy device and every approved threshold comparison. Missing target/threshold, shortened duration, filtered output or health event is BLOCKED/FAIL, never inferred PASS.
safety_gate: Exclude OS disk, active mounts, protected RAID members and valuable data before fio.
Require explicit target/serial match and a read-only semantic dry validation.
Abort on any write indication, path drift, SMART/media/AER error or thermal limit.
Do not replace43200 seconds with a smoke run under the same testcase identity.
expected_evidence: Target serial/path/topology, mount/RAID/OS exclusion and ownership proof
fio artifact identity and exact hashed job file
Full structured/console output showing achieved profile and duration
Versioned threshold matrix and IOPS/BW/latency comparisons
test_case.recovery: On target mismatch, write indication, error or thermal breach, stop without automatic retry, preserve evidence, confirm data/device health and restore any temporary host/cache settings under the approved storage procedure.
